analytical_question: Should the marketing team use AI for product drafts over four weeks?
general_et_finding: Generative AI has demonstrated gains on writing tasks and substantial use among workers.
application_finding: Drafting captions appears feasible. Technical accuracy and layout could consume the time saved.
organization_specific_finding: Approved briefs and a technical reviewer make a reversible trial possible.

evidence.claim: Access to ChatGPT reduced average time by 40% on sampled professional writing tasks.
evidence.notes: No screenshot extraction, product verification or Canva comparison; do not transfer the effect size.

evidence.claim: About 45% of employed respondents reported using generative AI for their job in Q2 2026.
evidence.notes: Worker denominator, any job use; no evidence of peer deployment for this workflow.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: No measured local advantage over manual Canva drafting.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in a trial; local results unknown.
risk_governance_implication: Check technical claims and keep drafts internal.
recommendation_management_implication: Experiment for four weeks on archived briefs against the current method.
change_monitoring_triggers: Consider adoption if quality and efficiency improve.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Obtain local time and error data before adoption.
